name: United Kingdom
notes: House of Commons: 650 seats, first-past-the-post. 2024 result (with two notional re-attributions): Labour 411 (33.7%), Conservatives 121 (23.7%), Liberal Democrats 72 (12.2%), SNP 9 (2.5%), Sinn Fein 7 (0.7%), Reform UK 4 (14.2%), Green 4 (6.8%), Plaid Cymru 4 (0.7%), DUP 5 (0.6%), SDLP 2 (0.3%), Alliance 1 (0.4%), UUP 1 (0.3%), TUV 1 (0.2%), Restore Britain 1, Speaker 1 (Chorley), Independent 5, Your Party 1 (Islington North). Notional: Rupert Lowe's Great Yarmouth follows him from Reform to Restore Britain, and Jeremy Corbyn's seat is Your Party's. The NI parties, Speaker, independents and Your Party have no polling, so their seats hold the baseline. Next general election due no later than 15 August 2029.
